item.description:
Nexa 1.0.11

  • Once a week, each chat is reminded of the relays you use, after a random delay. A contact who was away for more than two weeks while your relays changed now still finds you.
  • Nexa's signed list of extra backup relays can now also be signed with a backup key kept off the developer's Mac, so the list keeps working even if that Mac is lost.
  • Retired nostr-pub.wellorder.net from the backup relays.
